annotations.title: My hearing notes waiting to be posted

description: Signed-in Pro or Firm attorneys only. Lists the hearing notes the attorney formatted in THEIR OWN Comp Desk Pro Workspace and sent with "Post Hearing Notes in Case Management OS via Claude" (drafts never appear): for each, the id, case label, WCB number, hearing date, purpose, WCLJ, WCB status (HS / NFA / FTP), the system the attorney chose, how many to-dos it has, the next date, and whether it is queued or already posted. Newest hearing first. Call it to find the notes to post, then get_hearing_note for each. Notes are client-confidential: use them only for that entry.

status.description: queued (default): waiting to be posted. entered: already posted. all: both.
